params._maxReimbursement: Cap on a stranger sweeper's reimbursement.
params._minSweep: Minimum gross balance required to trigger a sweep.
params._tip: Flat caller bonus in 6-decimal USDC units.

params.newFeeRecipient: Replacement fee recipient (zero is valid when                         newFeeBps == 0, disabling the fee path entirely).

balance().notice: ERC-20 USDC balance of this slot (6-decimal units).

initialize(address,uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Called exactly once by SlotFactory immediately after cloning.

maxReimbursement().notice: Hard cap (6-decimal USDC) on what a stranger sweeper may be         reimbursed. If gas + tip exceeds it, sweep() reverts GasTooHigh         rather than letting a ceiling-gas sweep eat the payment.

minSweep().notice: Minimum gross balance (6-decimal USDC) required before         sweep() will distribute funds.  Prevents dust sweeps.

resolveQuarantine(address,address,uint16.notice: Called by the current merchant to resolve a quarantine.         Allows replacing BOTH the merchant and the feeRecipient so that         a subsequent sweep can succeed regardless of which address caused         the quarantine. This is the ONLY function that may change merchant         or feeRecipient, and only from the quarantined state.         Validation mirrors initialize():         - newMerchant must be non-zero.         - If newFeeBps > 0 then newFeeRecipient must be non-zero.         - newFeeBps must be <= 1000.

sweep().notice: Permissionless sweep. Forwards USDC to merchant and feeRecipient,         reimbursing the caller for gas (in USDC) plus a flat tip.         Checks-Effects-Interactions order:           1. Checks       : balance, minSweep, blacklist probes           2. Effects      : quarantine flag written if needed           3. Interactions : SafeERC20 transfers, then event         ReentrancyGuard prevents a reentrant call between transfers.

tip().notice: Flat caller tip in 6-decimal USDC units added on top of the         gas reimbursement.  Set by SlotFactory at initialisation.

usdc().notice: ERC-20 USDC token for this slot (6-decimal interface only).
